projects.title: SPECTER
projects.subtitle: Post-Quantum Stealth Addresses • Ethereum • Sui
projects.description: Post-quantum stealth address protocol for Ethereum and Sui. Pay any ENS (.eth) or SuiNS (.sui) name and SPECTER derives a fresh, unlinkable one-time address for every payment, secured by ML-KEM-768 (NIST FIPS 203). Ships with a TypeScript/WASM SDK on npm, a hosted API, an in-browser playground, and private trading on Yellow Network.
projects.longDescription:
Onchain payments today are fully transparent: every transfer exposes both sender and recipient. SPECTER fixes this. A recipient publishes one public meta-address (linked to their ENS or SuiNS name), and every sender derives a different one-time stealth address for each payment. Only the recipient can discover and spend those funds; to everyone else they look like transfers to random addresses.

The discovery path uses ML-KEM-768 (NIST FIPS 203), a lattice-based post-quantum KEM, so announcement data stays private even against "harvest now, decrypt later" quantum adversaries. One-byte view tags let recipients skip ~99.6% of announcements, scanning 80K announcements in about 1.5 seconds.

SPECTER is more than a hackathon demo. It ships as a full stack: a Rust/Axum backend and hosted API, a React web app (Setup → Send → Scan), the @specterpq/sdk TypeScript SDK compiled to WebAssembly so all cryptography runs on-device, an interactive SDK playground, a self-custodial "I don't trust SPECTER" recovery flow that works even if SPECTER goes offline, and a Yellow Network integration for anonymous state-channel trading. Started at ETHGlobal HackMoney 2026, won 3rd prize at the ETHCC[9] stage pitch, and selected for Founder School Cohort 2.
features: One-time stealth address for every payment: no public recipient trail
Pay human-readable names: ENS (.eth) on Ethereum and SuiNS (.sui) on Sui
View tags skip ~99.6% of announcements (80K scanned in ~1.5s)
@specterpq/sdk on npm: browser-first TypeScript + WASM, keys never leave the device
Interactive SDK playground and hosted REST API
Self-custodial recovery that works even if SPECTER goes offline
Private state-channel trading via Yellow Network

projects.title: VANTA
projects.subtitle: AI Security • Blockchain • Transaction Firewall
projects.description: A transaction firewall that sits between AI agents and the blockchain, scoring every proposed transaction through a policy engine and AI risk scanner before it can execute. No prompt, no urgency signal, and no model error can bypass the gate — only a tiered human confirmation can.
projects.longDescription:
VANTA is a transaction firewall that sits between AI agents and the blockchain, scoring every proposed transaction through a policy engine and AI risk scanner before it can execute. No prompt, no urgency signal, and no model error can bypass the gate — only a tiered human confirmation can.

As autonomous AI agents gain the ability to sign and broadcast transactions, a single compromised or confused model can drain wallets, manipulate protocols, or trigger irreversible on-chain actions. VANTA solves this by adding a deterministic, policy-first gate that runs before any transaction hits the mempool. Every transaction is scored, analyzed for risk, and held for human review if it exceeds defined thresholds — making AI-powered blockchain interactions safe by default.
features: Pre-execution transaction firewall for AI agents
AI risk scoring engine for every transaction
Zero bypass guarantee — no model error bypasses the gate

projects.title: AlphIQ
projects.subtitle: Alephium • Next.js • Web3
projects.description: The all-in-one Alephium dashboard for real-time blockchain analytics, dynamic contract insights, and gamified onchain scoring—complete with live network stats, wallet profiler, token flows, Ralph contract decoder, alerts, quests, and XP-powered achievements.
projects.longDescription: AlphIQ is designed to synthesize information, not just present it. The real challenge in Web3 isn't finding data; it's the cognitive burden of connecting disparate points: a transaction, a wallet's history, a contract's function, and a community campaign — into a single, understandable narrative. AlphIQ does that heavy lifting for you, weaving the data into a story and giving you a central role to play.

projects.title: EYI
projects.subtitle: Decentralized Identity • Web3 • ENS
projects.description: A comprehensive decentralized identity platform that empowers users to own, verify, and showcase their digital identity across multiple platforms. Connect your ENS to Self, GitHub, X (Twitter), and Farcaster to unlock your EYI badge and enjoy safer, smarter web3 interactions.
projects.longDescription: EYI is a next-generation decentralized identity platform that revolutionizes how users establish and maintain their digital presence in the web3 ecosystem. Built with privacy-first principles, EYI combines multiple verification layers to create a comprehensive identity system that's both secure and user-friendly. The platform addresses the fundamental challenge of digital identity in web3: proving you are who you say you are without compromising your privacy.
features: ENS integration for unified web3 identity
Self Protocol for private personhood verification
Farcaster integration for decentralized social identity
EYI Ring visualization for verification status
